text:
ops-elena: Quick heads up — Jensen Logistics reported ~8% DOA on the H200 shipment that arrived in AMS this morning. Need to coordinate RMA, reallocation, and whether we expedite replacements.
vendor-jensen: confirmed. DOA count 12/150 units, serial range H200-9800..H200-9811. AWB 123-456789. We've opened RMA cases; provisional ETA for replacements 10-14 business days unless customer chooses air-expedite.
supply-chain-sophia: can you attach the manifest and RMA case IDs? Are these units in the reserved EU pool or committed to customer orders?
vendor-jensen: manifest attached in portal — link: https://jensenlogistics.example/awb/123-456789 , RMA IDs: RMA-98721..RMA-98732. They're from our 'eu-topoff' allocation (reserved for infra).
liam: what's the impact on prod vs training? We have two queued jobs that require 48 H200 equivalents.
maya: also need cost delta if we air-expedite. Finance wants to know if we eat expedite fee or charge to allocations.
finance-mark: rough estimate for air-expedite is +$11k per unit duty+air; insurance might cover DOA if claim accepted. We need photos and depot inspection notes within 72h.
arjun: can we borrow 10 H200 from research pool in IAD for 2 weeks? Will need network cross-region routing and KV cache warmers — ops team can handle.
ops-elena: short-term borrow sounds reasonable. Proposal: reallocate 10 units from research (IAD) to eu-prod for two weeks, pause noncritical training queues, and queue air-expedite for remaining 2 DOA units if finance approves.
supply-chain-sophia: note customs HS code for replacement air shipments: `HS8471.80` — vendor must include for faster clearance.
vendor-jensen: acknowledged. We can split shipment: surface replenish for 10 (ETA 7 days) + air 2 units (ETA 48-72h) once expedite confirmed. To expedite, PO amendment + expedite code required: `EXP-AIR-007`.
ops-elena: action items:
- vendor-jensen: upload depot inspection photos + RMA notes to portal and confirm AWB amendments (due EOD)
- finance-mark: confirm if expedite cost is billable to infra vs vendor insurance (24h)
- arjun/liam: coordinate cross-region borrow and temporary routing (ASAP)
- supply-chain-sophia: prepare customs paperwork template and updated manifest
rma-bot: AUTO: RMA cases created: RMA-98721..RMA-98732. Inspection due by 2025-06-10. Status: pending-depot-inspection.
liam: can someone paste the AWB format we're using? need to push to our tracker.
vendor-jensen: AWB CSV sample:
```
awb,serial,model,qty,eta
123-456789,H200-9800,H200,1,2025-06-04
```
maya: :thinking: if insurance denies claim, what's fallback? Do we absorb cost or decommission older inventory?
finance-mark: fallback options: claim denied -> vendor credit negotiation (starting point 60% of unit value) or use reserve budget line `INFRA-RMA-2025` (approval required).
arjun: can we do temporary container-level pooling? i.e., mark the 10 borrowed units as 'ephemeral' so accounting knows they're on loan.
ops-elena: yes, we'll tag them `loan: IAD->AMS (2w)` and include a rollback ticket. I'll follow up with a short runbook for KV warmers.
supply-chain-sophia: i've created a placeholder ticket in SCM tracker -> https://scm.redwood.example/tickets/SCM-1428
vendor-jensen: will confirm packing list after depot inspection. Also note: any partial replacements may be consolidated in one AWB to reduce customs fees.
maya: thanks — let's sync in 1hr if vendor confirms photos. :thumbsup:
liam: +1
finance-mark: ok, will update on expedite funding in next 3h.
ops-elena: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as source of truth. Meeting invite sent for 11:30 to finalize decisions.
